sahneler.metin: Before dawn, a UPS cargo jet crashed short of the runway in Birmingham.
It hit trees and a hill, and both pilots were killed.
The approach was flown at night without vertical guidance.
An autopilot mode wasn't set as intended.
The jet descended too steeply and too low.
Neither pilot called for a go-around.
Fatigue was found to be a factor.
Rest rules for cargo pilots came under renewed scrutiny.

aciklama:
UPS 1354 hit a hill short of the runway in Birmingham. The cause: continued unstable non-precision approach below minimums, compounded by fatigue.
